rule: A source enters D only because it supplies a named input required by accepted A-C. A binding describes the source itself, not the investigation history. First-party Osservatorio records are ordinary operator inputs, not an external authority problem.

sources.name: Regional monitoring observations and campaign workbooks
sources.purpose: Supply the observed sample, plant or survey unit; sampling date and location; species; published result; and links to the confirming report.
routes: https://dati.puglia.it/ckan/dataset/dati-monitoraggio-xylella-fastidiosa
https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services
https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/gps/mtdcrept/accuracy/index.htm (device term, corpus/sources/positional-qualification/records.json)
https://arifpuglia.tuttogare.it/gare/dettaglio.php?codice=42 (device procurement, same record)
https://www.istat.it/storage/cartografia/confini_amministrativi/non_generalizzati/2026/Limiti01012026.zip (Puglia's extent for the grid distortion, same record)
sources.population: Every record of the twelve campaign workbooks, the CKAN release and the 101 observation point layers of the eight SIT services that publish them: 4,318,100 observations, 2,320,354 distinct, all hosts and all result states.
sources.reader: cordon_d.monitoring.observations, distinct_observations, detection_days, occasion_sets, located_observations, located_positives; cordon_d.spatial.positional_qualification
sources.open: Cross-release identity is unreliable for 2013–2017: the workbooks carry no reference and the SIT views use daily counters. A counter value one view reuses on a day stays uncorrelated; one used once in each of two views still correlates them, and such groups are exposed as disagreements or cannot be told from coincidence. The positional qualification is a stated device term plus grid distortion, against the ground. Not held: the device and capture mode per record (GNSS fix or map placement), per-fix accuracy, re-sample links, and the device before late 2024. Plant identity and the official finding belong to the population and report rows.

sources.name: Adopted survey plans and pest listings
sources.purpose: Supply the operative survey design for a campaign, area and host population, and the pest and host listings that classify an observation.
routes: Regional plans and national programmes retained as Stage A sources under regulation/
EU quarantine-pest and host listings retained under regulation/closure/eu/
sources.population: The plan and listing versions reached by accepted A provisions; their stated values are already Stage B parameters.
sources.reader: Stage B parameters supply the stated values; the finite population and strata per campaign are established with the plant and surface population row
sources.open: Establish the per-campaign target population and strata when the plant and surface population row exists.

sources.name: Official laboratory result documents
sources.purpose: Supply the laboratory's stated result for each designated test with its analyte, the sample identity, and the report's identity and dates for the samples the report names.
routes: DOCUMENTO_CONFERMA and LNK_DOCUMENTO_SELGE links published in regional monitoring records
https://webadf.sit.puglia.it/openDoc/apridocumento (confirmation letters and rapporti di prova)
http://cartografia.sit.puglia.it/doc/xylella/ (subspecies-identification rapporti)
sources.population: Every report referenced by an admitted monitoring release, followed through consequential report, annex and correction relationships.
sources.reader: cordon_d.reports, cordon_d.report_relations and cordon_d.findings; explicit extraction through scripts/read_reports.py
sources.open: SPEC.md owns which laboratory rows are completed. Inside the reach, a row or observation stays open with the cause its reading establishes: a publisher reference the reading does not recover, a printed reference no routed observation claims, a source association that conflicts with the row's host or printed coordinates or needs a host the row leaves unresolved, a conflicting or unstated sampling date, a report the source declares superseded, or a result part the source does not bind to a sample. Predecessor candidates retain unverified identity components; issue dates and referenced predecessor dates remain distinct. Administrative annexes can establish a derived occurrence correspondence without equating identifier strings.

sources.name: Adopted demarcated-area geometry
sources.purpose: Supply the infected, containment, buffer and other legally consequential area containing a location on the event date.
routes: https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/Operationals/DatiPubbliciFasceXF/MapServer
https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/Operationals2/DatiPubbliciFasceXFBandoPSR/MapServer
sources.population: Every geometry version required by an accepted A provision interval, together with the act that adopted it.
sources.open: Reacquire the current and consequential historical versions and bind each version to its adopting act.

sources.name: Cadastral parcel geometry and references
sources.purpose: Supply the parcel geometry and cadastral reference containing or intersecting a relevant plant or work location.
routes: https://wfs.cartografia.agenziaentrate.gov.it/inspire/wfs/owfs01.php
https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/Background/Catasto/MapServer/2
sources.population: The parcels spatially reached by an admitted finding or removal population; national AdE geometry is the current reference where available.
sources.open: Reacquire the required parcel population and preserve source cadastral identifiers. Geometry alone does not establish ownership or authority to enter.

sources.name: Osservatorio removal determinations and incorporated annexes
sources.purpose: Supply the issued removal measure, its operative branch, date, referenced plants or parcels, and any explicit supplement or correction.
routes: https://burp.regione.puglia.it/bollettini
https://www.regione.puglia.it/documents/736605/
https://cartografia.sit.puglia.it/doc/xylella/ (determinations reached from admitted report identities)
https://mdp.giustizia-amministrativa.it/visualizza/ (TAR Puglia and Consiglio di Stato decisions on an order, GA XML: the annulment basis)
https://openga.giustizia-amministrativa.it (Consiglio di Stato decision indexes searched for appeals)
sources.population: Every Osservatorio removal order, admitted by liveness: an order is in the population until execution or withdrawal closes it. Each order brings every held act that states a change to it and every court decision on it.
sources.reader: cordon_d.case_prescriptions (each order's whole operative text); cordon_d.held_acts (the changes held acts state to an order); cordon_d.judgments (the annulment basis: the court's own disposition); cordon_d.source_associations (native plant/report annex associations). Annex positions remain unread.
sources.open: Annex positions remain unread, so the plants and parcels an order lists by position do not reach C from the order. Annex association reading does not establish administrative effect, withdrawal or whole-document coverage. A change a held act states that no A row records leaves the order's dueness unknown. Resolve page-boundary fragments and the conflicting earlier administrative target reached by a laboratory identifier correction; INPUTS.md row 6 owns the dependency.

sources.name: Notice, publication and owner-response records
sources.purpose: Supply the notice route the act declares, the publication duty's record, the recipient-effect event and the owner's response when an accepted A or B rule depends on them.
routes: The determination's own text (declared route: reasoned immediate-effect clause, act-specific recipient-number finding)
The competent municipality's albo pretorio record of the seven-day publication
https://burp.regione.puglia.it/bollettini and the regional sites the plans name
The Osservatorio's communication record and municipal notification attempts (recipient effect)
PEC transmission to ARIF and the Prefettura (administrative event)
ARIF's authenticated election record or the owner's PEC (response)
OpenWeb albo register exports (openweb/albo/csv.php): ARIF's own albo (arif.soluzionipa.it) and the competent municipality's (Fasano, Modugno, Montemesola)
JCityGov albo detail pages and their posted documents (<comune>.trasparenza-valutazione-merito.it, papca/display)
TAR decisions stating an order's delivery, posting, request or reply (the removal-orders court route)
sources.population: The act text, publication record, communication and response events attached to an admitted removal matter; not every notice published by every municipality.
sources.reader: cordon_d.notices and cordon_d.events; cordon_d.notice_routes (each order's own mass-publicity basis); cordon_d.removal_events (publication records connected to an order's identity and adoption); cordon_d.albo_postings (albo register rows and posted documents attached by the identity they print); cordon_d.judgments (dated events a court decision states about an order)
sources.open: Select the source by the Law 241 Article 21-bis route A selects for the act and recipient; an immediate-effect or cautionary clause makes the measure operative but is not notification. A publication record proves the publication duty and anchors the election window; by itself it establishes neither recipient effect nor silence, refusal, breach or cost liability. Sending, delivery, publication, recipient effectiveness and response stay distinct.

sources.name: Protected-plant status and required permission records
sources.purpose: Supply an individual plant's protected status and, only where that status changes removal, the applicable permission or decision.
routes: https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/Operationals/UliviMonumentali/MapServer/1 (listed trees) and /0 (provisional trees, DGR 720/2025), captured whole by scripts/acquire_protection.py (corpus/sources/protected-status/register.json)

The L.R. 14/2007 list acts as published on BURP (https://burp.regione.puglia.it/documents/20135/<folder>/DEL_<n>_<year>.pdf, or the ordinary bulletin that carries an older act), each act's decision, history table and deletion annex (corpus/sources/protected-status/acts.json)
The official monitoring observations of the affected plants and of the negative olives within 50 m (rows 1 and 2), with MONUMENTALE_ARIF and NOTE_RILEVATORE from every view that prints them
The plant points the held removal orders print in their annexes (corpus/sources/removal-orders/records.json)
The competent authority's actual permission record for the affected plant or parcel
sources.population: The affected plants (the in-reach positives and the plants the held removal orders print, each order plant taking the record of the positive it coincides with within 1 m), the negative olives C may place in their 50 m zones, and the register entries within 50 m plus both errors of an affected plant; each entry's own list acts. It is not the register, and not only the positives. Permission records only where a protected plant's branch requires them.
sources.reader: cordon_d.protection (scripts/read_protection.py): register entries and key causes, each entry's act chain from the acts' decisions, recitals and history table, trees a deleting act lists, survey batches and their measured bounds with the 2011 check read from the held capitolato, the printed-parcel gross-error screen against SIT Catasto layer 2 (a screen only, never a bound term), the monitoring record and D's reading of each note, measurements, the note-code rule and candidates
sources.open: DGR 720/2025 lists 3,517 deleted trees; 3,391 rows print a key and a point the reader reads, 126 are unread, and the deleting act prints no approving act for them, so C reads a deleted tree's listing before deletion unknown; DGR 1193/2021's 34 and DGR 1491/2020's 2 deletions (before the reach) are unread. The gross-error screen cannot place 75,790 entries whose printed parcel is not in the September 2021 Catasto cartography (1,923 of the 11,679 printed parcels; sampled points lie in a renumbered parcel of the same foglio), nor 25 with no particella and 60 with no point; they are listed with the cause. The census tag as card is read from the held tags: the capitolato states the key N_Fg_P_cod_ISTAT and no tag. Investigate PPTR, municipal planning or a landscape authorization only when the affected plant's accepted branch requires it.

sources.name: Current owner, occupier and public-land standing records
sources.purpose: Supply the person or public body with the legally consequential relationship to the affected parcel or plant.
routes: The removal determination's incorporated annex (addressees by comune, foglio, particella)
Later acts that correct listed owners
The Osservatorio's case record and transmitted cadastral/owner data
A competent public asset register when the affected parcel is public land
sources.population: The addressee positions of an admitted removal measure and its corrections, and the people and parcels reached by an admitted finding.
sources.reader: Generic record and document readers; no current source-specific consumer
sources.open: The annex establishes the position the act published for each parcel, not that the named person held the land; an effective correction act replaces the listed position for the parcels it names, with its effect against the corrected recipient following the notice route. Current standing beyond the latest act needs the operator's matter or a competent register; cadastral geometry and public-land catalogues are candidates until they do.

sources.name: Osservatorio and executing-body operational records
sources.purpose: Supply assignment, field assessment, treatment, removal, completion and lawful cost facts required by the accepted chain.
routes: The Osservatorio's casefile and field systems (presided execution record, countersignature, photograph, assignment, verification, cost determination)
ARIF or other executing-body records incorporated into the matter
Removal orders for the lawful work basis (removal-orders route)
sources.population: The operational records for the admitted finding and resulting work, including corrections and completion evidence.
sources.reader: cordon_d.evidence, cordon_d.events and source-specific readers still to be implemented
sources.open: No public procedure manual can supply an unseen operational fact. A coercive-direction or execution-priority act is not proof of completed removal; a published removal label or removed-plant layer is a lead to a first-party record, not a removal occurrence, and the retained SIT capture holds no removed-plant layer after 2017. At deployment these are first-party operator inputs, with unavailable fields left unknown.

sources.name: Official vector and treatment observations
sources.purpose: Supply observed vector state or treatment performance when an accepted computation requires it.
routes: Official Osservatorio, ARIF and incorporated scientific monitoring publications
sources.population: The observations for the place, period and intervention evaluated by the accepted consumer.
sources.reader: Generic table and document readers; source-specific reader not yet selected
sources.open: Identify the exact C consumers before acquiring a publication series. General Xylella research is not an operational input by default.

sources.name: Italian civil calendar
sources.purpose: Supply weekends and national holidays for B clocks expressed in working days.
routes: Italian national holiday law and enacted one-off changes
sources.population: The bounded calendar years required by accepted B clocks.
sources.open: Extend only when an accepted clock reaches a year not currently represented.
